name: Citizens Militia
text: At the end of the environment turn, this card deals the non-environment target with the highest HP 2 melee damage.

name: Hostage Situation
text: Whenever a hero is dealt damage, that hero's player discards a card. At the start of the environment turn, this card deals each hero target 1 melee damage.

name: Police Backup
text: Each player may draw a card. The hero target with the lowest HP deals 1 melee damage to each villain target.
